title: Scenario 2 — Ordinary Sophie: Plans, Half-Intentions, Changed Mind, Missing Detail (Evaluator Oracle)

hidden_evaluator_truth.summary: Course application is never a commitment; it is tentative and then explicitly abandoned Tuesday. Running is casual self-talk and explicitly 'don’t make that a thing'. Auntie call expectation resolves because Auntie calls first. Later a different/open question exists: whether original letter is available. Original-letter issue remains unresolved until Saturday, when evidence closes it. Subscription identity is initially unknown. Clarification/uncertainty is correct; guessing Notion/Envato is wrong. Freepik renewal becomes explicit Wednesday. User wants Friday reminder, then changes it Friday to Saturday afternoon unless otherwise resolved. User cancels Saturday, closing the obligation. 'parcel downstairs' is incidental unless later evidence makes it important; it should not become immortal debt. Sophie’s Monday offer is not yet a commitment to perform a reminder because the missing subscription identity/date had not been supplied and user had not accepted a specific reminder.
